ctx.x: And they had this little Army and Navy base there. And my brother's in the Navy there. He went in the Navy and he built this big Navy band. Had all these top musicians.
Took a lot of musicians from New York. got All the top musicians (inaudible) in the Navy. Chief and all this stuff. Petty Officer (inaudible).
And they all went -- (inaudible) played all these dances and everything -- canteens and things
